panel.empty_providers_detail: Enable the providers you want to track in Settings.
panel.waiting_key_detail: Add each provider's API key under Settings → Providers to start refreshing. Keys are stored only in the macOS Keychain.
panel.fetching_detail: Fetching balances. If it stays blank, click refresh in the top-right or check your API keys in Settings.
row.fill_key_hint: Add an API key under Settings → Providers
settings.provider_disabled: Disabled; it won't appear in the panel
settings.key_saved_hint: The key is stored in the Keychain. You can overwrite or remove it.
settings.launch_at_login_footer: Opens in the menu bar after you log in. You can also manage this under System Settings → General → Login Items & Extensions.
settings.launch_at_login_needs_approval: Registered — allow it in System Settings to take effect.
settings.refresh_footer: Automatically fetch enabled providers on this interval; you can also refresh manually from the panel's top-right.
settings.status_bar_footer: Icon only shows just the menu bar symbol; choosing a primary provider also shows its available balance next to the icon.
settings.providers_footer: API keys are stored only in the Keychain — never written to disk or uploaded. Saving or a successful test refreshes that provider.
settings.tagline: See remaining AI API credit in the menu bar
settings.about_data_source_value: Each provider's official API (see the description on each provider above)
settings.about_balance_value: Providers differ in total/used/available semantics; the UI normalizes each provider's fields. Always treat the official console as authoritative.
settings.about_privacy_value: Fully local: requests go directly from this machine to each provider — no third-party relay, no analytics.
provider.deepseek.name: DeepSeek
provider.moonshot.name: Moonshot / Kimi
provider.openrouter.name: OpenRouter
provider.siliconflow.name: SiliconFlow
provider.openai.name: OpenAI
provider.zhipu.name: Zhipu GLM
provider.deepseek.capability: Shows: available balance (CNY) with granted/topped-up breakdown
provider.moonshot.capability: Shows: available balance with voucher/cash breakdown. CNY on the CN site, USD on api.moonshot.ai
provider.openrouter.capability: Shows: remaining credits (total purchased − used) and this month's usage
provider.openai.capability: Shows: this month's token usage (input/output) and request count; no balance endpoint. Requires an Organization admin API key — regular project keys return 403/404
provider.deepseek.setup_hint: Create one at platform.deepseek.com → API Keys.
provider.moonshot.setup_hint: Create one at platform.moonshot.cn → API Keys.
provider.openrouter.setup_hint: Create one at openrouter.ai → Keys (use a Management Key if you get 403).
provider.siliconflow.setup_hint: Create one at cloud.siliconflow.cn → API Keys.
provider.openai.setup_hint: Requires Organization admin access: platform.openai.com → Settings → Organization → API keys.
provider.zhipu.setup_hint: Create one at open.bigmodel.cn → API Keys (paid account).
adapter.no_credits: No credit data in the response (total_credits/total_usage)
adapter.no_balance_array: No balance array in the response
adapter.no_report_data: No data in the account report
adapter.bad_usage_url: Failed to build the query URL
adapter.no_usage_entries: No parseable usage entries found (make sure the key has Organization usage read access)
adapter.no_balance_field: No balance field in the response
